verdict.rationale: Clerky's Partner API covers only Delaware C-Corp formation document sets: create, fill forms, submit, and poll lifecycle state. Its MCP server is described as read-only and team-scoped. Nothing in the evidence shows contract renewal or deadline tracking, alerts, or agent actions taken before a lapse. Polling formation state is an adjacent capability, not this one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent monitor contract renewals and deadlines through the product's API and act before they lapse
